payload.title: File:Atractosteus simplex FOBU788.tiff
payload.description_html:
A dark brown gar facing right and angled up on pale tan stone. The gars diamond-shaped scales are all mostly still in place and shine a bit from light off photo.

The most common gar species from Fossil Lake. Its maximum size was about 3 feet. Catalog number FOBU788
